title: Symlinked command folders are not followed
observed: walkMarkdown in internal/claude/commands and the plugin commands walk skipped symlinked folders (DirEntry.IsDir is false for a link), so commands inside a linked folder never loaded.
expected: Claude Code 2.1.283 lists commands inside a symlinked commands folder as <folder>:<name> (checked by capturing its first request with linked/zqlinked.md).
